The pieces are arranged in rows on a light cream textured background.

A collection of metal cutting dies featuring holiday and winter-themed designs including a decorated Christmas tree with ornaments, evergreen branches, a staircase railing, a stocking, bows, decorative elements, and various rectangular frames. The dies are gray metal with detailed outline patterns.
